overall: The AG found the March 1, 2011 open session minutes substantially complied with the Open Meeting Law, but the executive session minutes were too sparse, and ordered new executive session minutes within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to create and maintain accurate minutes of its March 1, 2011 meeting, including a member's proposed edits that were not adopted.
allegations.key_passage: we believe the Committee substantially complied with the requirement that it provide an accurate and sufficiently detailed summary of the discussion.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the March 1, 2011 executive session minutes were inaccurate and insufficiently detailed for a discussion lasting about an hour and twenty-five minutes.
allegations.key_passage: After reviewing the Committee's executive session minutes, however, we find that the Committee did not include the minimum detail required by the law.

remedy: Draft and approve a new set of March 1, 2011 executive session minutes within 30 days, with a summary of each discussion detailed enough for a non-attending member of the public to understand what occurred.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee to draft and approve a new set of executive session minutes within 30 days.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
